review.name: Celestial Lion
findings: All twelve original source head/body slices and all 216 actual equipped-technique frames inspected. Mane beneath cheek bends and elongates independently during recoil/death, while front legs splay during walk/gallop. Actual wind strike, wind breaker and open wound have a much worse strike peak at .48 seconds: torso folds beneath the platform, head reaches floor height and feet sink below it; feet remain below platform during early recovery. Cast-driven techniques also lose front support. Original battle raw captures exist but have not been inspected. Original wing silhouette remains recognizable and wing curves must be conserved while fitting four visible limb chains and coordinated actions. Freeze and visually verify original soles and pick joints before repair.

Original twelve source head/body slices and all 216 actual technique frames inspected. Cheek/mane distorted in recoil and death, front legs splayed in gait and actual strikes folded torso beneath platform. Original four-view paw overlay revealed automatic clustering had selected the ground-level tail tuft as a rear paw; corrected and frozen before repair. Original shoulder/elbow/hip/hock ray picks recorded. V1 rejected with 430 geometry warnings and V2 with 89; only one raw slice per rejected candidate actually inspected and no rejected candidate technique frames inspected. V3 removes the discontinuous wing-weight exception and preserves original wing curves while rebinding legacy leg influences continuously. Complete mane binding, four fitted chains, coordinated support actions and fitted neck/head preserve geometry, UVs/textures, all 27 original bone frames/inverses and 224 unaffected curves; fourteen joints appended. V3 all twelve source raw slices and all 216 actual technique frames inspected and pass. Independent face passes 1882 clip poses plus 468 blends; all 1591 geometry poses have zero warnings. Fresh final source/battle and runtime second pass pending.

Final separate second pass actually inspected all 24 raw source/battle head/body slices, all 32 low/medium production transition slices, 24 advancing companion idle frames, all 216 actual equipped-technique frames in twelve lossless native strips and sixteen atlas cells. All pass. Frozen face 1882 clip poses plus 468 blends and full-geometry 1591 poses per asset pass. Twelve anatomical regression tests plus three animation-bank tests and production build pass. Original and final paw surfaces are tested at 481 times per action, including between keys. Whole-roster and live release pending.

companionTechniqueAudit.label: independent-mythic-015-anatomical-v3-final-techniques
companionTechniqueAudit.finding: All nine actual techniques inspected front and side at twelve times on rebuilt battle asset. Complete jaw and mane hold shape, four legs remain connected to the torso, and no strike sinks below the platform. Attack intentionally lifts the left front paw with three supporting feet; cast and recoil keep four supporting feet.

review.faceCameraCoverage: One winged lion head. Brow, muzzle, chin, side jaw, both horns and cheek mane inspected. Horn and mane patches enlarged before probes so the original battle mesh retains measurable coverage. Wings, legs and curled tail require full motion review.
